### Egypt Falls to Babylon
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://www.ligonier.org/learn/devotionals/egypt-falls-babylon
Passage: Ezekiel 30:10-11
Points:
- God revealed His power in the Exodus so nations would recognize Him as the true Lord.
- Egypt forgot the lessons of Moses and remained hardened in pride and idolatry.
- By attempting to aid Judah against Babylon, Egypt actively resisted God's ordained judgment.
- God raised up Nebuchadnezzar to dismantle Egypt's might and demonstrate His sovereign authority.
- Human pride blinds people to God's past works and risks leading them into opposition to His will.
